papers.title: Rectified Looped Transformer
papers.desc: Replaces direct feedback in a looped Transformer with a rectified-flow-style interpolation toward each loop's endpoint prediction, keeping state norms bounded; at 278M it lowers Pile perplexity at matched depth and, trained at 8 loops and run at 32, reaches 17.72 perplexity versus 57.72.

papers.title: Folding Language Models into Themselves
papers.desc: Introduces Concertina, which folds each group of adjacent pretrained decoder layers into one shared block looped N times with SVD-initialized per-step LoRA mixed by a per-token gate; a 2.27B fold of Qwen3-4B distilled on 22B tokens keeps 84% of the teacher and beats Qwen3-1.7B on six of eight benchmarks.

papers.title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models
papers.desc: Studies how to cut the per-iteration KV cache of depth-recurrent language models, comparing looped hybrids with mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet mixers, a Parcae-style workspace, and recurrent KV replay; replaying KV from every third of six loops scores 18.71 CORE against 18.96 with separate caches.

papers.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LoopFill, a training-free decoder for looped LLMs that merges suffix-lookup drafts and shallow-loop predictions into one draft tree processed by the shared block in one batch, reaching 5.85x greedy speedup on Ouro-2.6B and 5.13x on Huginn-3.5B, 40% and 25% above LoopAhead.

papers.title: When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?
papers.desc: Tests eleven ways to loop a middle block of vision-language embedding models and proves image-first causal loops keep image states query-independent; on MMEB-V2 an added loop on Qwen3.5-2B loses 0.46 points to its single-pass control, while natively looped LoopVL-1B gains 4.23.

papers.title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Introduces LoopSkim, which lets every intermediate loop readout of a looped LM check prompt-lookup draft tokens and fixes sampling noise per position to stay lossless; without training it averages 7.66x over autoregressive decoding under greedy decoding and 1.73x the speedup of LoopSpec.

papers.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
papers.desc: Compares a latent-feedback Transformer, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, with a same-size Transformer given equal compute or epochs from 60M to 778M parameters; feedback saves up to 48% of compute and 47% of unique data once data per parameter is ample.

papers.title: Latent Fact Composition under Next-Token Training
papers.desc: Introduces Baton looped transformers that pass a decoded bridge-entity embedding into the second loop; two of three variants answer about 99% of two-hop questions with unseen bridges under answer-only training, but next-token training makes that accuracy rise and then decline.

papers.title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Feeds already-computed hidden states from later token trajectories into each loop of a parallel looped Transformer through lightweight attention residuals; at eight loops this removes training-loss spikes and cuts perplexity 3.4-17.1% over vanilla parallel loops for 0.3% extra decoding time.

papers.title: LoopZip: Visual Token Compression for Efficient Looped Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Compresses visual tokens in looped vision-language models without training by selecting tokens from attention over the first two calls of a shared layer and fitting one shared value correction to both calls; LoopVL-1B keeps 97.16% of its accuracy and runs 2.01-2.47x faster.

papers.title: Proximal Targets: Training Looped Refiners on Problems with Many Correct Answers
papers.desc: Trains each pass of a TRM-style looped refiner toward the correct answer nearest its own input draft instead of one stored answer, making every answer a fixed point; a 1.7M-parameter model solves 98.8% of multi-answer Sudoku puzzles versus 2.5% with the standard target.

papers.title: LoopPrune: Recurrent Pruning for Looped Diffusion Transformers
papers.desc: Prunes looped diffusion Transformers with one mask shared by every loop position, scored by shared-removal effects and position variation, then recovers each loop position against a dense teacher; at 30% structured pruning Looped-DiT B/16 keeps 93.14% of dense accuracy.

papers.title: Where Global Context and Weight Sharing Work in Compact Vision Backbones
papers.desc: Ties repeated MBConv blocks of a trained EfficientNet-B0 to shared kernels with per-pass BatchNorm; alternating two templates in Stage 6 ([B1, A, B, A]) cuts parameters by 10.9% and reaches 70.92% ImageNet accuracy after one epoch, 1.84 points below the unshared control, while single-template tying trails by 6.66.

papers.title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
papers.desc: Replaces TRM's two states and nested loops with one state updated by a bank of per-channel exponential moving averages and read out from slow channels only; at equal parameters and compute it reaches 92.1% on Sudoku-Extreme versus 88.3% for TRM and does not collapse late in training.

papers.title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LoopCache, a lossless self-speculative decoder for looped Transformers that updates drafts from every intermediate loop and cycles through loop-specific KV caches so each step reads one loop's cache, averaging 10.25x and 14.56x speedups over WaveFront Decoding and LoopSpec on 4K-128K contexts.

papers.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Shows that entering a looped LM at its final K of T passes over a T-pass KV cache beats matched early exit after entry fine-tuning, and fuses late-pass blocks, pipelined cache completion, and shared-GEMM Wake verification in one CUDA graph for up to 5.23x (Ouro-2.6B) and 8.42x (Huginn-3.5B) greedy-exact speedups.

papers.title: Recurrent Vision Language Models Solve the Shell Game
papers.desc: Introduces RecurrentVLM, which makes each attention layer of Qwen3.5-4B recompute the keys and values of finished frame groups from its own output so its state updates once per frame group; it reaches 99.6% on MET-Bench and 99% on 50-swap shell games after training on at most 30 swaps.

papers.title: Fold the Loop: Decoding-Time KV Memory for Looped Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Introduces FoldCache, which keeps an exact prefill but lets groups of recurrent invocations of the same weight-tied module share that group's final visual KV during decoding; on LoopVL it stores about half the prefix KV at full-cache accuracy and fits up to 1.7x larger batches (2.6x with FoldCache-Lite).

papers.title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference
papers.desc: Introduces LoopedWAM, a world action model whose video and action experts each store 12 blocks and loop a shared 6-block core to 30 executed layers, with decoupled video/action depths and elastic self-distillation; the 0.58B policy reaches 96.1% on LIBERO and 91.9% on RoboTwin 2.0.

papers.title: PSTO: A PDE-structured transport operator with shared implicit updates for multiscale CDR systems
papers.desc: Introduces PSTO, a convection-diffusion surrogate that applies one learned transport block for a fixed number of relaxed fixed-point iterations to approximate an implicit update; four iterations cut one-step error 5.8x versus one, and 100-step rollout error falls at least 50% below the best neural baseline.

papers.title: dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement
papers.desc: Restructures LLaDA into a Prelude-Loop-Coda model that reruns shared layers 16-21 with Parcae-style input injection inside each denoising step before tokens are committed; with multi-depth SFT, two extra loops lift GSM8K from 75.0% to 79.2%, and no compared accelerator beats it on both accuracy and loop-adjusted TPF.

papers.title: Circular Predictive Coding Unlocks Effective Depth
papers.desc: Closes a predictive-coding network into a loop of shared learned maps whose energy equilibrium is an equivalent DEQ's fixed point, trained by local equilibrium propagation; it reaches 93.54% on CIFAR-10 and, with a 105k-parameter recursive variant, 99.3% on Sudoku-hard over 1,024 relabelled views.

papers.title: Mixture of Latent Recursions for Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.desc: Introduces MoLR, a LoRA variant that reapplies one shared r-by-r latent transformation between the down- and up-projections with a per-token threshold router deciding when to stop; with LoRA's parameter count it averages 86.51 on GLUE with RoBERTa-base versus 84.65 for LoRA and leads on reasoning and vision tasks.

papers.title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
papers.desc: Introduces Model Carving, which gives every sublayer application its own learned scalar gate, one per loop in looped Transformers, and removes closed sublayers during pretraining; a carved 1.3B four-loop model drops 45 of 192 sublayer applications and still beats its full-depth looped baseline (0.683 vs 0.704 bpb).

papers.title: LoopSight: Looped Vision Transformers with Gated Prediction Memory
papers.desc: Introduces LoopSight, a looped ViT whose Gated Prediction Memory keeps a gated readout state separate from the shared core's evolving computation, reaching 67.4% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 (+6.6 over LoopViT at comparable size) and staying stable out to 24 loops.

papers.title: Bridging Teacher-Student Capability Gaps with Recurrent Computation
papers.desc: Compares weight-shared looping and cross-token recurrence for expanding 0.4B distilled students at fixed backbone size, finding that recurrent students keep improving with larger teachers, reaching 47.2% GSM8K and 34.2% MATH500 under on-policy distillation.

papers.title: R2WM: Recursive Reasoning Wireless Model for Long-Horizon mmWave Beam Prediction
papers.desc: Introduces R2WM, a TRM-style recursive model that reuses a two-block causal-attention backbone across nested latent and prediction updates for mmWave beam prediction, reaching 0.9597 average normalized beamforming gain vs 0.8629 for an LLM baseline with 99.1% fewer parameters.

papers.title: When do stored facts become available in looped transformers?
papers.desc: Shows with tuned lenses and probes that stored facts in looped transformers become readable earlier across loops than in untied models of equal unrolled depth, that heavier memorization delays retrieval, and that patching an entity subspace redirects multi-hop answers in 79.07–98.57% of cases.

papers.title: When Wrong Answers Remain Unsettled: Failure Dynamics in Recurrent Reasoners
papers.desc: Shows that wrong answers of a Sudoku-Extreme HRM are mostly unsettled computation: given one more inference budget, 0.95 of solved but only 0.18 of wrong endpoints keep their answer, and extending recursion depth (+5.6 points) beats noise-based reselection (+4.8).

papers.title: What Makes Recurrence Generalize Across Lengths?
papers.desc: Shows on a swap-based state-tracking task that weight-tied recurrent Transformers length-generalize only with atomic operation tokens and no absolute positional encoding, reaching 90.6% exact match on 11–19 swaps vs 28.1% for a compute-matched untied model.

papers.title: loopxDINO: Dense Visual Prediction via Iterative Latent Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces loopxDINO, a weight-tied cross-attention decoder looped over frozen DINOv2 features with step-conditioned adaLN, reaching 85.66% mIoU on Pascal VOC at two iterations with 72.5% fewer trainable parameters than a 6-layer decoder, though accuracy drops with more iterations.

papers.title: MoR4Rec: Mixture-of-Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
papers.desc: Introduces MoR4Rec, a Mixture-of-Recursions sequential recommender whose router assigns each item a recursion depth through a shared Transformer block with recursion-wise KV reuse, averaging +2.28% Recall@5 over the strongest baseline on three datasets.

papers.title: Loop-Count Schedules in Looped Transformers: An Empirical Study
papers.desc: Shows that the lower bound of the training loop-count schedule decides whether gated loop passes act as full layers (gates 0.6–0.9) or small corrections (0.1–0.5) in 46M–110M looped LMs; R∼{2,3,4} reaches 2.909 nats vs 2.951 for the parameter-matched plain model.

papers.title: PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency
papers.desc: Introduces PackLoop, an exact self-speculative decoder for looped LMs that places speculative positions only in per-loop KV-read rows already being read, beating the best existing schedule at 161 of 164 concurrent-load points on Ouro (median 1.25×, up to 1.76×).

papers.title: A Pipeline-Parallel System for Depth-Recurrent Models
papers.desc: Introduces Loop-PP, a pipeline-parallel training system that schedules repeated cross-stage visits of a shared layer stack in interleaved 1F1B without duplicating weights, cutting peak memory by up to 32.8% and raising best throughput by up to 12.7% on 8B–60B looped MoE models.

papers.title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces DyLoMo-DiT, a diffusion Transformer that loops weight-shared middle layers with sparse experts and gives low-noise steps more passes, cutting ImageNet-256 FID by 11–24% vs DiT and 36–56% vs DiT-MoE at matched parameters and compute.

papers.title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
papers.desc: Introduces LoopRes, which retrofits pretrained LLMs into looped models whose layers attend over earlier loop outputs through trainable loop-aware keys, improving Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT at 2× compute vs 13.9% for the best prior looping method.

papers.title: Edge-RecViT: Efficient Vision Transformer via Semantic-Refined Dynamic Recursion
papers.desc: Introduces Edge-RecViT, combining a fully shared recursive ViT hidden layer with an edge-aware token ranker that allocates per-token depth and early exits for parameter- and FLOP-efficient vision.

papers.title: Implicitly-Defined Neural Networks for Sequence Labeling
papers.desc: Defines sequence hidden states jointly through a learned implicit system and solves the coupled nonlinear equations to enable non-causal bidirectional interactions for sequence labeling.

papers.title: ChainGPT: Dual-Reasoning Model with Recurrent Depth and Multi-Rank State Updates
papers.desc: Introduces ChainGPT, a dual-reasoning recurrent-depth architecture that combines multi-substep state updates and state-guided sparse attention to move reasoning into latent computation, with adaptive stopping as a supporting mechanism.

papers.title: MoDr: Mixture-of-Depth-Recurrent Transformers for Test-Time Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces MoDr, which adds multi-branch routing to a depth-recurrent Transformer so looped models can explore solution paths more adaptively at test time.

papers.title: Polymorphic Universal Transformer
papers.desc: Introduces the Polymorphic Universal Transformer, adding conditional sparse subspaces and uncertainty-aware depth scheduling to shared-parameter recurrence to reduce compute while mitigating representational collapse.

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
papers.desc: Argues that once a looped language model's recurrent states approach fixed points, the endpoint can replace the trajectory, enabling truncated backpropagation, terminal KV sharing, distilled prefill up to 1.79x faster, and RL updates from saved rollout states about 2x faster; it shapes those fixed points with a depth prior learned from prediction feedback plus an entropy term and with orthogonal input injection, and at 1.6B parameters the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.

papers.title: Universal Speech Transformer
papers.desc: Adapts the Universal Transformer to speech recognition with shared iterative encoder and decoder computation, dynamic depth, one-time positional encoding, and full hidden-state updates.
